text: Toy, children's product suppliers target Việt Nam through IBTE 2026

HÀ NỘI - Manufacturers from Việt Nam, mainland China, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan (China) will gather in HCM City this December to showcase toys, baby products and stationery, with the aim of expanding distribution networks and strengthening business connections in Việt Nam and Southeast Asia.

The 2026 HCM City International Baby Products & Toys Expo Vietnam Stationery Expo (IBTE 2026) will take place from December 10 to 13 at the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Centre (SECC), Tân Mỹ Ward, HCM City.
Jointly organised by Chaoyu Expo and VINEXAD, it is expected to cover up to 15,000 square metres, with around 600 booths.
The event comes amid growing opportunities in Việt Nam's toy, baby products and stationery markets, supported by the country's young population, economic growth and rising purchasing power.
IBTE 2026 will feature five main product categories: Trendy Toys, Baby Products, IP Licensing, Toys and Stationery.
Exhibits will include educational and creative toys, building blocks, remote-controlled vehicles, plush toys, robot models, dolls and licensed character merchandise.
The stationery section will present school supplies, creative stickers and products developed in collaboration with intellectual property (IP) owners.
The baby products section will showcase diapers, children's clothing, footwear, mother-and-baby accessories and travel safety products.
Exhibitors will include Vietnamese companies Thien Thac Vietnam, Eight Corners and HuaYi Vietnam, alongside international manufacturers and suppliers.

Several companies will present their own brands, while some exhibitors hold licences to produce products featuring internationally recognised intellectual property, including Lamborghini, BMW, Disney and Sanrio.
Retailers and supermarket chains such as Mykingdom, AEON, MINISO and Lotte Mart are also expected to visit the exhibition to explore business cooperation opportunities.

Marking the tenth anniversary of IBTE's development in Southeast Asia, the 2026 event will include the announcement of plans to expand its exhibition network across ASEAN, alongside long-term policies and services for buyers.
Industry forums, networking activities and business-to-business matchmaking sessions will also be held.

The Southeast Asia IP Copyright Forum will bring together experts to discuss intellectual property compliance and protection, while the VIP Buyer Programme will provide tailored matchmaking services and customised exhibition itineraries.
The exhibition will also host the Speed Cubing Open in Vietnam 2026 in cooperation with the Rubik's Cube manufacturer Stellar Cube. - BIZHUB/VNS
